notes.time: a day lesson (training-plan.md §1: every lesson but the night lesson and the night check rides by day)
notes.wind_kt: calm (inferred: the route's times and the approach are learnt without a wind)
notes.start: the base's parking spot for the unit (modern-iaf/data/airbases, airbases.md §5); the altitude: the terrain's ground there (elevation_m without the terrain)
notes.runway: the base's runway the take-off missions use; the tower turns it into the wind
notes.route: the two approach fixes on the runway's extended centreline: 12 NM at 5,000 ft and 10 NM at 3,000 ft above the field, 300 kt (inferred)
notes.training.time_budget_s: the start-up, the taxi and the lesson's flight with time to spare (inferred)
notes.training.end_hold_s: a fail shows its reason 5 s before the debrief: time to see the result
notes.training.end: the lesson ends with the jet back on its spot and the engine off (training.md §16.3)
notes.weather: heavy rain: the cloud deck from about 450 m above the ground to 5,500 m (docs/rendering.md §10.1), so the departure and the fixes are flown in cloud and the runway shows below about 1,500 ft
